data.comment:
# Comfy Seedream 5.0 Pro- Image Edit

Edit images with precision using Seedream 5.0 Pro, targeting specific regions while preserving lighting, depth, and texture. The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 output image. Ideal for product photography edits, portrait consistency adjustments, and creating structured layouts with multilingual text. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_pro_image_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Convert the entire collage into a cohesive, realistic interior design photo of a cozy living room. Render the sketched bay window area on the left into a real window filled with potted plants, including Swiss cheese plants and a fiddle-leaf fig, with a lush forest view outside. Transform the sketched snake plant in the bottom-left into a real potted snake plant. Blend the elements seamlessly under warm, natural afternoon sunlight.
